{
  "name": "loss_tanh_advantage_regret",
  "intuition": "Use a pairwise regression-based paradigm that encourages the difference in log probabilities to align with the normalized advantage gap, using a smooth tanh-based penalty to softly constrain deviations, weighted by sample importance and scaled by regret.",
  "pseudocode": "adv_gap = advantage_w - advantage_l
regret = delta_regret
gap_norm = normalize(adv_gap)
scaled_diff = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / (abs(regret) + 1e-6)
loss_per_pair = tanh((scaled_diff - gap_norm) ** 2)
loss = mean(weight * loss_per_pair)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_regression",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap_delta_regret",
    "link_family": "tanh_squared_penalty",
    "agg_family": "weighted_mean",
    "constraint_family": "soft_saturation"
  },
  "operators_used": ["tanh", "sub", "mul", "div", "abs", "mean", "normalize", "add", "pow"],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": ["log_prob_w", "log_prob_l", "weight", "advantage_w", "advantage_l", "delta_regret"],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
    regret = batch['delta_regret']
    adv_gap = adv_w - adv_l
    gap_norm = ops.normalize(adv_gap)
    safe_regret = ops.abs(regret) + 1e-6
    scaled_diff = (lpw - lpl) / safe_regret
    diff_squared = ops.pow(ops.sub(scaled_diff, gap_norm), 2)
    penalty = ops.tanh(diff_squared)
    loss = ops.mean(penalty * weight)
    return loss"
}

  "pseudocode": "losses = -logsigmoid(clamp(alpha*scale*(lpw-lpl) - 0.1*(cost_gap), -20, 20))\nweighted_losses = losses * weight if weight else losses\nloss = sum(weighted_losses) / sum(weight if weight else 1)",

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))\n    cost_a = batch['cost_a']\n    cost_b = batch['cost_b']\n    gap = (cost_b - cost_a).detach()\n    x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * gap\n    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)\n    losses = -ops.logsigmoid(x)\n    if weight is not None:\n        weighted_losses = losses * weight\n        total_weight = ops.sum(weight)\n    else:\n        weighted_losses = losses\n        total_weight = losses.new_ones(losses.shape).sum()\n    loss = ops.sum(weighted_losses) / total_weight\n    return loss"
}

{
  "name": "loss_rank_gap_huber_entropy_advantage",
  "intuition": "This loss uses a rank-based pseudo-margin combined with a robust Huber-style penalty on the difference of advantages, incorporating entropy regularization to encourage confident predictions. It shifts from margin-based losses to a rank and robust regression paradigm, with a multiplicative sigmoid link capturing confidence scaling and aggregation by sum weighted by instance importance.",
  "pseudocode": "delta = rank_gap(advantage_w, advantage_l)\nhuber_loss = where(abs(delta) < delta_threshold, 0.5 * delta^2, delta_threshold * (abs(delta) - 0.5 * delta_threshold))\nentropy_reg = entropy_w + entropy_l\nloss = sigmoid(scale * huber_loss) - entropy_weight * entropy_reg\nweighted_loss = weight * loss\nfinal_loss = sum(weighted_loss) / sum(weight)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_rank_regression",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap_entropy",
    "link_family": "sigmoid_scaled",
    "agg_family": "weighted_sum",
    "constraint_family": "huber_clamped"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "rank_gap",
    "abs",
    "relu",
    "sigmoid",
    "mul",
    "sub",
    "add",
    "mean",
    "sum"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_w",
      "advantage_l",
      "entropy_w",
      "entropy_l"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    entropy_w = batch.get('entropy_w', ops.zeros_like(lpw))\n    entropy_l = batch.get('entropy_l', ops.zeros_like(lpl))\n\n    delta = ops.rank_gap(adv_w, adv_l)  # rank difference of advantages\n    delta_abs = ops.abs(delta)\n\n    delta_threshold = float(extra.get('delta_threshold', 1.0))\n    scale = float(extra.get('scale', 3.0))\n    entropy_weight = float(extra.get('entropy_weight', 0.1))\n\n    # Huber loss calculation\n    huber_loss = ops.where(delta_abs < delta_threshold,\n                           0.5 * delta * delta,\n                           delta_threshold * (delta_abs - 0.5 * delta_threshold))\n\n    entropy_reg = entropy_w + entropy_l\n\n    # apply scaled sigmoid link to huber loss and subtract entropy regularization\n    loss = ops.sigmoid(scale * huber_loss) - entropy_weight * entropy_reg\n\n    weighted_loss = loss * weight\n    loss_sum = ops.sum(weighted_loss)\n    weight_sum = ops.sum(weight)\n\n    final_loss = loss_sum / (weight_sum + 1e-8)\n    return final_loss"
}

{
  "name": "loss_tanh_advantage_gap_rank",
  "intuition": "Use a hinge-style ranking loss with tanh link on advantage_gap combined with rank normalization, focusing on relative ordering rather than margin-based probability.",
  "pseudocode": "ranked_gap = rank_gap(advantage_gap)
scaled_gap = tanh(scale * ranked_gap)
loss = relu(margin - scaled_gap)
if weight:
  loss *= weight
return mean(loss)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_ranking",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "tanh",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "relu_margin"
  },
  "operators_used": ["rank_gap", "tanh", "relu", "mean", "mul"],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": ["log_prob_w", "log_prob_l", "weight", "advantage_gap"],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    margin = float(extra.get('margin', 0.5))
    scale = float(extra.get('scale', 3.0))

    ranked_gap = ops.rank_gap(adv_gap)
    scaled_gap = ops.tanh(scale * ranked_gap)
    loss = ops.relu(margin - scaled_gap)

    if weight is not None:
        loss = loss * weight
    return loss.mean()"
}

  "name": "loss_diffadvantage_tanh_relu_costgap",
  "intuition": "Use the difference of advantages with non-linear transformations (tanh and relu) on the advantage gap and cost gap to amplify signals, then apply a difference-based loss without sigmoid or logsigmoid, aggregating by weighted sum.",
  "pseudocode": "adv_diff = tanh(advantage_w) - tanh(advantage_l)\ncost_effect = relu(cost_gap)\nloss_raw = cost_effect - adv_diff\nloss = mean(weight * loss_raw)",

    "constraint_family": "nonnegative_relu"
  },
  "operators_used": [

    "sub",

    "mean"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_w",
      "advantage_l",
      "cost_gap"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    cost_gap = batch['cost_gap']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    adv_diff = ops.sub(ops.tanh(adv_w), ops.tanh(adv_l))\n    cost_effect = ops.relu(cost_gap)\n    loss_raw = ops.sub(cost_effect, adv_diff)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss_raw = ops.mul(loss_raw, weight)\n    return ops.mean(loss_raw)"
}

  "intuition": "Probabilistic pairwise preference likelihood with stable clamping and consistent advantage gap sign; repaired to ensure numerical stability and correct exponent sign.",
  "pseudocode": "u_diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l\nadv_gap = advantage_w - advantage_l\nadv_gap_clamped = clamp((adv_gap + 1) / 2, 0, 1)\np_pref = sigmoid(u_diff)\nlog_p_pref = log(clamp(p_pref, eps, 1))\nlog_one_minus_p = log(clamp(1 - p_pref, eps, 1))\nweighted_loglik = weight * (adv_gap_clamped * log_p_pref + (1 - adv_gap_clamped) * log_one_minus_p)\nloss = -mean(weighted_loglik)",

  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    eps = 1e-8\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    adv_gap_raw = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)  # fixed sign for consistent pairwise preference direction\n    numerator = ops.add(adv_gap_raw, lpw.new_tensor(1.0))\n    denominator = lpw.new_tensor(2.0)\n    adv_gap_clamped = ops.clamp(ops.div(numerator, denominator), lpw.new_tensor(0.0), lpw.new_tensor(1.0))\n    u_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    p_pref = ops.sigmoid(u_diff)\n    log_p_pref = ops.log(ops.clamp(p_pref, eps, 1.0))\n    one_minus_p = ops.sub(ops.ones_like(p_pref), p_pref)\n    log_one_minus_p = ops.log(ops.clamp(one_minus_p, eps, 1.0))\n    weighted_loglik_pos = ops.mul(adv_gap_clamped, log_p_pref)\n    weighted_loglik_neg = ops.mul(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(adv_gap_clamped), adv_gap_clamped), log_one_minus_p)\n    weighted_loglik = ops.mul(weight, ops.add(weighted_loglik_pos, weighted_loglik_neg))\n    loss = ops.neg(ops.mean(weighted_loglik))\n    return loss\n"
}

  "pseudocode": "x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * cost_gap\nx = clamp(x, -20, 20)\nloss_forward = -logsigmoid(x)\nloss_backward = -logsigmoid(-x)\nweighted_forward = loss_forward * weight\nweighted_backward = loss_backward * weight\nloss = (sum(weighted_forward) + sum(weighted_backward)) / (2 * sum(weight))",

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    eps = 1e-8\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', lpw.new_ones(lpw.shape))\n    cost_gap = batch.get('cost_gap', None)\n    if cost_gap is None:\n        zeros = lpw.new_zeros(lpw.shape)\n        cost_gap = batch.get('cost_b', zeros) - batch.get('cost_a', zeros)\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))\n    x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * cost_gap\n    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)\n    loss_f = -ops.logsigmoid(x)\n    loss_b = -ops.logsigmoid(-x)\n    weighted_loss = loss_f * weight + loss_b * weight\n    total_weight = 2 * ops.sum(weight).clamp(min=eps)\n    loss = ops.sum(weighted_loss) / total_weight\n    return loss"
}
